text:
Sylvie: posted a quick update to the Private setup wizard Connectivity step. New prototype in Figma: /designs/onprem/check-explain-v1. Need fast UX + privacy + a11y read before handoff.
Noah: looked through. Strong preference to lead with a human explanation: 'Why we check: ensures models can be downloaded and health signals reach Redwood.' then the technical status.
Rachel: agree. Also add clear time estimates for actions: 'Quick check (5-20s)' and 'Detailed trace (2-3 min)'. Users hate guessing.
infra-bot: probe 1843210050 result=BLOCKED target=api.redwood:443 probe=tcp timeout_ms=4000 hops=4
Sylvie: copy suggestion for hero: "Checking outbound access to Redwood (no network changes)." subcopy: "Quick checks detect common firewall/proxy issues; full traces gather extra detail for support."
Noah: UX detail: show status chip + short reason (e.g., 'Blocked  port 443') first, then a collapsed 'Technical details' area with monospace output and a copy icon. collapse by default for non-SRE users.
a11y-bot: accessibility checklist: 1) status chip must include text + icon and not rely on color only; 2) announce status changes with role=\"status\" + aria-live=\"polite\"; 3) modal must trap focus and restore on close; 4) red error color contrast >= 4.5:1.
Rachel: for the 'Share anonymized diagnostics' flow, show a consent modal that lists fields we'll include and a sample redacted snippet. Default to hashed hostnames and summarized hops; full IPs only if user explicitly enables them.
privacy-bot: recommended defaults: analytics = summarized hop counts and error codes; support bundles = hashed hostnames + summarized hops; explicit opt-in required for raw IP lists. Include explicit line: 'No credentials or auth headers will be included.'
Noah: microcopy: primary action 'Quick check (5-20s)', secondary 'Run full trace (2-3 min)'. On quick check show a small inline timeline: 'probing -> analyzing -> summary' and an optimistic toast 'Quick check usually completes in <20s'.
Sylvie: include a tiny 'Why are we checking this?' tooltip that expands inline (not modal) saying: 'We validate egress to our service endpoints to ensure model downloads and telemetry succeed.' link it to a support article.
infra-bot: note: quick_check endpoint flagged as low-cost in telemetry: quick_check=true
Rachel: mobile: stack actions vertically; copy & download buttons full width. Consent modal full-screen on small devices.
Noah: acceptance criteria for eng: 1) quick vs full probe endpoints; 2) plain-language explanation up front with collapsed technical details + copy button; 3) consent modal showing sample redacted payload and default redaction toggles; 4) aria-live region + focus management; 5) telemetry default summarized-only; quick checks annotated.
Sylvie: thanks all. I'll update Figma and attach the sample redacted blob. Handoff scheduled for tomorrow's dev sync. Tagging @noah for final copy. :white_check_mark:
